selection_reason: Fresh branch review found that NativeFixedFunctionDrawReadiness copied requiredTextureMask from activation but did not include that mask in the draw snapshot token. A copied draw readiness could therefore change the required PS texture-stage mask without invalidating its original identity, which is unsafe before the planned aggregate multi-stage binding work.
